hypothesis.title: Central Bank Balance Sheet Growth and Subsequent US Equity Returns
hypothesis.statement: Growth of the Fed's total assets over four weeks predicts a higher S&P 500 return over the next 20 sessions.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The slope of the 20-session-ahead S&P 500 log return on the 4-week change in Fed total assets is zero.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The slope is positive (HAC one-sided p < 0.05 and circular-shift placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Publication-lagged weekly predictive regression with Newey-West HAC errors and circular-shift placebo
hypothesis.metric_name: slope of 20d forward return on 4-week change in Fed assets
